title: platymiscium floribundum var. nitens
intro: Platymiscium floribundum var. nitens, commonly known as the "Quebra-pedra", is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Platymiscium floribundum var. nitens include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiparasitic activities, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
